design.pilot_plans: first ten original Week 4 samples in each test
design.refinement: one coarse seed per k; midpoint to adjacent coarse values on each axis; retain centre; no extrapolation
design.shortlist: two distinct parameter settings per k from completed eligible pilots; add frozen B4/E8 baselines
design.geometry: unchanged 21-coordinate separate-harm geometry, reduced mean-worry coordinate
design.data: all-20-feature-complete development respondents, original order; no held-out responses
design.weights: WGT normalized within included country, then equal country totals; recalculate after sampling
design.confirmation_limit: fresh resamples of the same development countries, not independent validation
design.selection_limit: best tested setting within this bounded search, not a guaranteed continuous optimum
design.plateau_review: report nearby settings and reference ARIs; no new automatic semantic threshold
